title: Mai hu paani suno meri kahani
body:
Mai hu paani suno meri kahani
Main hi taskeene labe tishna dahan hota hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi darya kabhi aankhon se rawa hota hoon
Hain labe Asgare besheer ka ehsaan mujh par
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho jahan majlis e Shabbir waha hota hoon
Main hoon paani Auno meri kahani...x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindagi jisse rawa hain woh rawani main hoon
Pyaas ko jisse hain nisbat woh kahani main hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Be talab hoon talabe tishna dahani main hoon
Jab ye abaadi na thi tab se hi aabad hu main
<<DIVIDER>>
Khud hain Quran gawah duniya ki buniyad hoon main
Main hoon paani..x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Rahi har daur me masoomon se nisbat mujhko
Kar na paya koi paband shariat mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
Paak hoon aur taharat se hain ulfat mujhko
Khud sada deti rahi pyaas ne fitrat mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
Darde dil ke liye taskeen ka malham bankar
PAYE masoom se nikla hoon main zam zam bankar
<<DIVIDER>>
Main hoon paani....x2
Mere qisse hain bohot meri kahani hain bohot
<<DIVIDER>>
Barsare roo e zameen meri nishaani hain bohot
Khittae khushk hain kam dehr me paani hain bohot
<<DIVIDER>>
Rabbe Akbar ne bada martaba bakhsha hain mujhe
Sayyada ke jo haqe mehr main rakkha hain mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Main hoon paani ...x2
Main wuzu banke namazon ki ada tak pohoncha
<<DIVIDER>>
Banke zam zam kabhi kaabe ki faza tak pohoncha
Main tha pakeeza so main rahe wila tak pohoncha
<<DIVIDER>>
Yehi nisbat thi Jo main karbobala tak pohoncha
Do Moharram ko to alag the hi nazaare mere
<<DIVIDER>>
Utre alfaaq ke malik jo kanare mere
Main hoon paani....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Roze Aashur main ek aur hi duniya main raha
Ashk bankar nigahe Sayyada Zehra main raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Roshni banke kahi didae bina main raha
Auje kausain mila mashke Sakina main raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Sare maidan e wiga maujeza dikhlata raha
Hukme Sheh hota toh khaimon main chala aata main
<<DIVIDER>>
Main hoon paani....x2
Rubaru tha mera bemislo misaale chehra
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehrae Hazrat e Abbas woh aali chehra
Hashmi chand ka chehra tha jamali chehra
<<DIVIDER>>
Maine dekha tha jo gazi ka jalaali chehra
Khauf tab se hi mere dil se juda rehta hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Bas usi din se mera rang uda rehta hain
Main hoon paani...x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaya jab Saniye Karraar kanaare mere
Auj par pohonche muqaddar ke sitaare mere
<<DIVIDER>>
Mashk me jaane ko betaab the dhaare mere
Sadqe khud pyaas ne aa aake utare mere
<<DIVIDER>>
Roze Aashur yeh azmat bhi mili hain mujhko
Daste Abbas pe Maeraj hui hhain mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
Main hoon paani...x2
Log ab majlise Shabbir me late hain mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadqa Shabbir ka pyaason ko Pilate hain mujhe
Matami Shah ke aankhon se lagate hain mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab azadaar sabeelon me sajate hain mujhe
Zakhm e jaa saare hi seene ke liye aate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ambiya bhi mujhe peene ke liye aate hain
Main hoon paani. ..x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Yu mujhe sahebe zeeshan kiya pyaason ne
Dil e momin ka ek armaan kiya pyaason ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaat par meri hi ehsaan kiya pyaason ne
Apni majlis ka mehmaan kiya pyaason ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhme taaseere dare Karbobala milti hain
Mujhko peele to farishton ko shifa milti hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Main hoon paani... x2
Kya hain azmat meri aye duniya zara kar insaaf
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhoke kar deta hoon har daag e nidamat ko saaf
Ek ajab kaam yeh karta hoon main fitrat ke khilaaf
<<DIVIDER>>
Turbat e Hazrat e Abbas ka karta hoon tawaf
Mujhe yoon saya hain gazi ki alamdari ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Laazmi hissa hoon main aaj azadari ka
Main hoon paani.....x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil me ek noor ke didar ki hasrat lekar
Hoon rawa noor Ali main yeh taharat lekar
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekh Farhan sharaf leke sharafat lekar
Main hi chalta hoon arizon ki amanat lekar
<<DIVIDER>>
Rashk kyu kar na kare auj e suraiya mujh par
Baarwa aake bichaega musalla mujh par
<<DIVIDER>>
Main hoon paani....x2.
author: Farhan Ali
